all_constant_Y: deliver full logical range as a predefined uninformative branch; numerical failures separately counted
calibration_rank: ceil((B+1)*(1-alpha)); ties conservative; take maximum critical across required fixed worlds for each family
calibration_theory: Finite-world order-statistic coverage over independent calibration and new outcomes, for the frozen score algorithm. Does NOT prove real-football law belongs to these worlds or a continuum of unknown nuisance parameters.
eligibility: Projection-corrected joint equations mandatory for this task; uncorrected J0 remains a diagnostic ablation, not eligible. v9 selected it on width alone and is retained as an unadopted development decision; no calibration or approval used that decision.
fourth_step_gate: Approve only a scope-labelled validated working method; graph finite guarantees remain a reference. Absolute/global optimality and unqualified real95% guarantees are not claimed.
informativeness: At least25% narrower mean CORE width than the matched G4 graph/bounded reference. No real p-value or observed significance used for selection.
joint_estimation: Eliminate common unknown mean in covariance moment equations usingM=I-X(X'X)^+X'; joint GLS/BLUP solves projected Henderson equations. Second-moment working model, not binary Gaussian likelihood or an assertion of exact MINQUE optimality.
scale_floor: maximum of fitted variance and0.25*sum a^2; not a dependence-robust variance bound by itself
scale_guard: eta times the largest actual-dateOU quadratic form over365/1460/2920days, grouped by era/type/home-unit/away-unit. eta is a score regularizer selected on development data, not a claimed true variance floor. Calibration/validation are independent and unchanged.
scope_reasons: Extend required scope to the PREVIOUSLY FAILED C13 tau2920d before new calibration/testing; only permanent global shock and globalt scale remain outside. This expands coverage obligations; old failures are retained.
selection: After v11 validation revealed inefficient width allocation, fit bounded target-tail factors only on first50 DEVELOPMENT replicates and compare gamma0/.5/1 on latter50. Freeze before NEW v12 calibration/validation/parameter holdout. Earlier validation is not reused as new acceptance.
